info.name: VCF 9.1.1 - Production Non PCI - Migrate PGs (no scripts)
info.description:
Production Non PCI - create port groups with source names and VLAN IDs.

Source 'VMware HCIA Distributed Switch' (95 PGs) -> VDS 1 = prdvcfwcl01-data-vds01
Source 'DMZ-Networks-PRD' (5 PGs) -> VDS 2 = PRD-VCF-WLD-DMZ-VDS

No scripts. Copy IDs from responses into environment variables between steps. Disable SSL verification in Postman if vCenter is self-signed.

request.description: Copy the response HEADER 'vmware-api-session-id' into env variable vim_session (Current value). Re-run if you get NotAuthenticated.

item.name: 04 - List network folder children (find the 2 VDS)

request.description: Lists VDS and port group refs. Candidate VDS moids (dvs-xxxx) -> env dvs1_moid / dvs2_moid, then confirm names with 05a / 05b.

Source VDS 'VMware HCIA Distributed Switch' -> target VDS prdvcfwcl01-data-vds01. Response = task ref: copy 'value' -> env task_moid, run '90 - Check task' until state=success, then send the next request.

item.name: 90 - Check task (re-run after every create call)

request.description: Wait for state=success. state=error -> read the 'error' field (usually a duplicate PG name).
Expected port group count (incl. 1 auto uplink PG): 95 + 1
Expected port group count (incl. 1 auto uplink PG): 5 + 1
Put any PG moid from 91/92 into env pg_check_moid.
